Bug_Details:
This method compares an expression of the form (e & 0) to 0,
which will always compare equal.
This may indicate a logic error or typo. (e & 0)

Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test cases call the showBug method with different values (5, 0, -1). Since the method always returns true due to the bug (e & 0) == 0, the assertions using assertFalse will fail, thus triggering the bug.
